mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations WHERE code=#{code} AND id!=#{excludedId})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.organizations SET code=#{organization.code},name=#{organization.name},organization_type=#{organization.organizationType},tax_code=#{organization.taxCode},phone=#{organization.phone},email=#{organization.email},address=#{organization.address},contact_full_name=#{organization.contactFullName},contact_position=#{organization.contactPosition},contact_phone=#{organization.contactPhone},contact_email=#{organization.contactEmail},status=#{organization.status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{organization.id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion}
